Cold plunge

FraminghamWestwood

A fresh perspective.

Meet the cold plunge in our Westwood Recovery Room. Take a look at the actual space, and decide how you would like to make it part of your visit.

Alternate with the infrared sauna or explore it alongside compression and red light therapy.

Two ways to visit

PEX clients: walk in during flex hours for shared open access. Monday–Thursday, 6 AM–6 PM; Friday, 6 AM–4 PM.

Private visits: reserve the Recovery Room outside flex hours at regular pricing.
